items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: And while I was with Solid Stan's band... we had Cecil Thornton, he was arranging... And Cecil Thornton helped me out quite a bit.

ctx.x: They might have these, it says the St. Louisianization.
No. No. That, they're trying to get Cecil Thornton. Thornton. Cecil Thornton. Thornton.
That's the name. I'll make a note on here then too.
